title: The pending-finish source-capture test waits out the real 40 s closing-settlement budget on every cargo test run
outcome: silent_check_outcome_source_captures_are_reported_or_explained covers its pending-finish case without spending the production REVIEW_FREEZE_TIMEOUT (40 s). Either a deadline already in the past is driven through engram_resolve_turn_checks_with_notices, or a cfg(test) settlement budget is used. The coverage stays deterministic.
acceptance: The pending-finish case still proves that a capture still pending at the settlement deadline yields the holder line "finish source snapshot was still pending", and that a capture arriving later is not lost to a cached empty report.
The test no longer waits the real 40 s settlement budget: its run time is bounded by the test's own scripted or past deadline, with no sleep or synthetic load.
The focused test passes on a host-recorded run.
